budget.lr_selection: validation balanced accuracy max; selected checkpoint is best validation epoch

C3.reason: not included in this frozen scout design

claim_ceiling: Rung1 seen-rule capacity-vs-architecture diagnostic only. No rung3, transfer, H0, H1, mechanism, agency, self, AGI, EGO, runtime, companion, or mainline claim.

decision_rules.H_arch: If Phase1 all-fail and Phase2 breakpoint is flat across C0,C1,C2, support architecture/strategy-limited over swept range and route downgrade_or_redesign.
decision_rules.H_cap_phase1: If any Phase1 capacity clears rule_count=172 admissibly, stop Phase2 and route reopen_rung3_powered_at_cleared_capacity after powered rung1 confirm.
decision_rules.H_cap_phase2: If Phase1 all-fail and Phase2 breakpoint(C2) > breakpoint(C0), support capacity-limited and route scale_up.
decision_rules.inadmissible: Any C0 consistency miss, leakage invalid, fair saturation on a claimed clear, ablation non-collapse on a claimed clear, replay mismatch, or protected-source mismatch blocks interpretation.

phase2.eval: held-out-episode evaluation on the selected seen train-pool rules

rule_subset.selection: deterministic no-replacement subsample of k TRAIN-pool rules for k<172

wall_clock.review_note: Claude sets any cap after dry-run review; null means no cap is frozen for this dry-run authoring step.
